name: pair
description: Pair programming: edits wait for your review, a shared notebook tracks decisions, and /pair switches the mode on or off.

maxReviewLines.title: Review size target
maxReviewLines.description: How many changed lines one edit should stay under. Claude is told to keep to it, and a review over it says so and can be sent back with Split.

reviewBash.title: Review what commands change
reviewBash.description: After a Bash command changes files in a git repository, walk through its changes in the review pane before Claude goes on. Takes two quick snapshots of the repository around every command.

editor.title: Editor command
editor.description: The command /pair drive runs to open your editor on the files you are taking over. It must return at once, as editor launchers do. The default, code, is Visual Studio Code.
